newsitem.title: USA: New York timecharter fixtures - August 28.
newsitem.headline: New York timecharter fixtures - August 28.

text.p: Polycarp (built 1990) 152,065 dwt del Dunkirk end Sept via Hampton Roads-Richards Bay redel S.Korea $15,000 daily China Steel.
Charmyl (built 1981) 26,151 dwt conbulker del S.Africa 2-3/9 redel Skaw-Cape Passero $3,850 daily Island View Shipping.
Merchant Pride (built 1990) 69,500 dwt del USG 5-12/9 redel Far East $11,000 daily plus $150,000 bb NSAC.
China Glory (built 1990) 65,562 dwt del Cont early Sept via USG redel Japan $10,500 daily CNR.
